paragraphs: The XF 2.7d was introduced with the original X250-generation XF in 2007. It uses the Ford AJD V6 — a 2.7-litre diesel V6 shared with several Ford, Jaguar, and Land Rover vehicles of that era. The XF 2.7d remained in production until 2015, when the X260-generation XF replaced the X250. The 2.7d was discontinued during the X250 run — later X260 XFs used a different 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel from Jaguar's Ingenium family instead, not the AJD V6.
